name: foxnne NAT III clouds (pass 4)
author: foxnne
description: UNTESTED DRAFT, pass 4. Per-weather, per-period sky for the 111 NAT.CS III weathers: haze, air, ozone, glow and sun strength follow the sun height and a per-weather moisture value; closed heavy-sky decks for overcast, rain, storm, snow and fog; storm lightning (Physical Sky); height-fog strength (Exponential Height Fog); ambient mix (Image Based Lighting); Ground Fog amounts. Needs a build that contains foxnne/heavy-sky, foxnne/lightning-fix and foxnne/ground-fog-near. Read notes/install-pass-4.md first.
